releaseNotes: 新增两套可选窗口保护：台前调度开启时，含“不处理”App 的分组会保护其他成员，全部为自动规则的前台组合也会在移入侧边栏后才分别开始计时；台前调度关闭时，屏幕上仍可见的自动规则 App 不会被处理，只有窗口完全被其他 App 遮住后才从零计时。分组保护仅在开启时请求辅助功能权限；屏幕可见保护无需额外权限且不读取屏幕内容。另优化规则选择器的文字对齐并保留彩色状态图标。
releaseNotesEn: Adds two optional window-protection modes. With Stage Manager on, a group containing an Ignore app protects its other members, while an all-automatic foreground group starts separate timers only after moving to the sidebar. With Stage Manager off, automatic-rule apps remain protected while any window is visible and restart timing only after all windows are fully covered. Group protection requests Accessibility only when enabled; visible-window protection needs no extra permission and never reads screen contents. Also aligns rule-picker labels while preserving their status colors.
